remarks: Everything is NEW-Just move right in!! Welcome to 6 Silvermine Ave. Unit 10,where every detail has been thoughtfully renovated to create a truly turnkey home. This beautifully updated and private condominium features brand new finishes, appliances, all never used and backed by warranties for added peace of mine. Great kitchen complete with granite countertops and ample beautiful cabinets.  The newly refinished hardwood floors add warmth and elegance throughout, while the bright, open living area flows through doors to your very private patio-a very happy relaxing place.  Additional highlights include new washer/dryer, private storage, and a very private setting within the small complex. Close to shopping, restaurants, parks, Metro-North, major highways, and everything the Norwalk area has to offer!  Combines modern comfort with exceptional convenience.
